proposed_abilities.description: Compile caller-supplied bounded public-HTTPS transport evidence without fetching or inferring an identity.
Create or verify an exact-origin Ed25519 key-holder declaration without establishing registry authorization or domain ownership.
Assess caller-supplied integrity, key, origin, freshness, and revocation evidence with no score or state effect.

notes: This descriptor is a declaration-only local hint, not an installed KINGDOM host contract or active Nen ability.

A valid signature establishes only that the embedded key signed the exact canonical declaration; it does not establish AgentTool registry authorization, domain ownership, authorship, identity continuity, consent, trust, reputation, or training permission.
Observation and assessment records have no WAKE, Chronicle, memory, observation-counter, KARMA, score, training, publication, or authority effect.
